items.title: Nvidia CEO Huang admits to affair, apologizes to employees as probe launched
items.summary: Investing.com -- Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang has apologized to employees after admitting to an affair with businesswoman Alice Huang, whom U.S. intelligence suspects is a Chinese spy. Huang told staff he was "deeply sorry", as the chipmaker’s board launches an independent investigation.
